description: Ministry of Wildlife and Forest Resources Conservation - The State Industrial Corporations Act No. 49 of 1957 Order Under Sections 3
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of legal regulations under the State Industrial Corporations Act, No. 49 of 1957. It contains an order that modifies the purposes and operations of the State Timber Corporation, which constitutes a regulatory framework change. While it mentions Minister Mahinda Amaraweera, it does so in the context of exercising statutory powers to make legal/regulatory amendments rather than focusing on government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities. The content fits Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications.
